description: Manages locales in Debian and Ubuntu systems.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name and encoding of the locales, such as en_GB.UTF-8. Before community.general 9.3.0, this was a string. Using a string still works.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the locales shall be present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Ensure a locale exists
  community.general.locale_gen:
    name: de_CH.UTF-8
    state: present

- name: Ensure multiple locales exist
  community.general.locale_gen:
    name:
      - en_GB.UTF-8
      - nl_NL.UTF-8
    state: present

return_values.name: mechanism
return_values.description: Mechanism used to deploy the locales. Returned: success Can only return: "glibc" "ubuntu_legacy" Sample: "glibc"
